entries.question: Opd appointment
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at KGMU, please follow one of the methods below. **Please note: Online registration is mandatory for all patients.**

### **Appointment Booking Methods:**
1.  **Online Portal (Recommended):** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in).
    *   Select State: **Uttar Pradesh**
    *   Select Hospital: **King George's Medical University (KGMU)**
    *   Click 'New Appointment' and follow the prompts.
2.  **Mobile App:** Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care** app from the KGMU Play Store and follow the same registration flow as the ORS portal.
3.  **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS with the text `"APPOINTMENT <NAME>"` to **8887019134**.
4.  **Phone:** You may call **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333** for assistance.

### **Important Information:**
*   **Registration Fee:** ₹50 flat for the OPD slip (payable via all booking methods).
*   **Arrival:** Please arrive at the hospital on the date and time specified in your appointment confirmation. Bring a printed copy of your appointment slip or the confirmation SMS.
*   **Referrals:** Patients coming from outside the city must bring a valid referral for their specific department.
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM–12:00 PM). The hospital is closed on Sundays.

**Medical Disclaimer:** I am an AI assistant and not qualified to provide medical advice or diagnosis. If you have specific symptoms or health concerns, please consult a qualified doctor at the KGMU OPD or visit the nearest emergency facility if it is a medical emergency. **For your safety, please do not share personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat.**

entries.question: Koi number hi nhi lgata hai baar baar maine try kiya hai APPOINTMENT ke liye mai bhut presan hu
entries.answer:
Main samajh sakta hoon ki aapko appointment book karne mein kathinai ho rahi hai aur yeh kaafi pareshani wali baat hai. KGMU mein bhid hone ke karan phone lines aksar busy rehti hain.

Agar phone nahi lag raha hai, toh aap ye **doosre vikalp (alternatives)** try karein jo zyada nishchit (reliable) hain:

1.  **Online Portal (ORS) - Sabse Best:**
    Sabse pehle [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jayein. Wahan apna mobile number daalkar register karein. Yeh portal 24/7 chalta hai aur isme kisi ko call karne ki zaroorat nahi padti. Aap wahan khud Neurology department aur date chun sakte hain.

2.  **Walk-in (On-Site) Registration:**
    Agar online booking mein dikkat aa rahi hai, toh aap **seedhe KGMU ke New OPD Block** mein subah jaldi (8:00 AM se pehle) pahunch jayein.
    *   **Zaroori cheez:** Apne saath **Aadhaar Card** aur **Mobile Number** zaroor rakhein (OTP ke liye).
    *   Counter par jakar aap wahan se ₹50 ki 'Parchi' (OPD slip) katwa sakte hain.
    *   *Dhyan rakhein:* OPD registration counter **1:00 PM** par band ho jaate hain, isliye jitna jaldi ho sake wahan pahunchein.

3.  **Emergency/Urgent Case:**
    Agar patient ki halat gambhir hai aur aap appointment ka wait nahi kar sakte, toh kripya samay barbad na karein aur seedhe **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** par jayein. Emergency services 24/7 khuli rehti hain.

**Ek zaroori baat:**
Main ek AI assistant hoon aur medical salah (diagnosis ya treatment) nahi de sakta. Agar patient ko tez bukhaar, behoshi, ya koi aur gambhir lakshan hain, toh kripya kisi doctor ya Emergency department se turant sampark karein.

*Aapki suraksha ke liye, chat mein koi bhi personal medical details, Aadhaar number, ya phone number share na karein.*

*   **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS with the text "APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]" to **8887019134**.
*   **Helpline:** You can call **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333** for assistance.
*   **Walk-in:** You can visit the on-site registration counters. Please ensure you have your **Aadhaar card** and an active **mobile number** with you to receive the OTP for registration.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM | Saturday: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Fee:** There is a flat fee of ₹50 for the OPD slip.
*   **Referral:** Patients coming from outside the city must bring a valid referral for their specific department.
*   **Pre-booking:** It is strongly recommended to pre-book your appointment to avoid long wait times.
